# Turtle Transformation Limited (The Authentic Leader Academy)

Turtle Transformation Limited is an Irish executive coaching and advisory practice. The site is presented in English.

## Key Pages
- [12-Month Executive Coaching](https://turtletrafo.com/): The primary offer, program details, pricing, and FAQ.
- [AI & Data Advisory](https://turtletrafo.com/data-ai-consulting/): A secondary advisory offer for organisations.
- [Our Journey](https://turtletrafo.com/about/): Founders Miriam and Dr. Markus Schmidberger.
- [Privacy Policy](https://turtletrafo.com/privacy/)
- [Imprint & Legal Notice](https://turtletrafo.com/imprint/)

## 12-Month Executive Coaching
- **Audience:** Senior leaders and founders.
- **Duration:** 12 months.
- **Cadence:** One 60-minute coaching session and one 30-minute practical application and training session per month.
- **Baseline assessments:** AQai Adaptability Assessment and Five-Mountain Leadership Assessment.
- **Core price:** €5,400, payable in two installments of €2,700.
- **Optional asynchronous support:** €280 per month, available Tuesday and Thursday.
- **Additional individual sessions:** €450 per hour.
- **Contact:** Request a confidential conversation by email at info@turtletrafo.com. A response is promised within 48 hours.

## AI & Data Advisory
A separate AI & Data Advisory practice for enterprise data, AI, and adoption questions, led by Miriam Schmidberger and Dr. Markus Schmidberger.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What does the coaching program cost?** €5,400, payable in two installments of €2,700.
- **What is included?** Two baseline assessments, a 60-minute coaching session each month, and a 30-minute practical application and training session each month.
- **Is support available between sessions?** Optional asynchronous Tuesday and Thursday support costs €280 per month.
- **Can I book additional time?** Additional individual sessions cost €450 per hour.
- **How do I make contact?** Email info@turtletrafo.com to request a confidential conversation. A response is promised within 48 hours.
